# Copilot instructions — Sicurre

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root first. It is the single source for the
runtime (Cloudflare Email Routing, FastAPI, React, Better Auth, Neon), the
branch chain, the gates to run before pushing, and the coding rules.

Earlier versions of this file described a Gmail and Cloud Run design. That
design is superseded (see `docs/adr/0001-cloudflare-email-routing-runtime.md`
and `docs/adr/0003-fastapi-hetzner-sidecar-runtime.md`) and must not be
reintroduced.
